content_data.meeting_title: Q3 European Network Expansion Strategy Review
agenda_items: Discuss partnership opportunities with regional carriers
Review budget allocation for infrastructure investments
Assess customer experience metrics and NPS trends
key_decisions: Selected strategic partnership with regional last-mile delivery network to improve rural coverage
Approved phased rollout of automated sorting facilities in three new markets over 18 months
Authorized investment in customer-facing tracking platform upgrade with enhanced visibility features
Postponed warehouse automation initiative in Southern Europe pending further market analysis
action_items: Commission third-party assessment of technology infrastructure scalability - Dimitri Volkov within 6 weeks
Negotiate partnership terms with selected carriers and present draft agreements - Amara Okonkwo within 30 days
Develop change management plan for operational teams affected by automation - Priya Sharma within 4 weeks
Conduct customer journey mapping workshops across key markets - Javier Ruiz to coordinate within 2 weeks
